scope: Speed only. With QS_ALI_LIN, QS_FRM_ALI and QS_LIN_FAC /= 0 (the local formal-solution ALI linearization) in the main continuum loop, VAR_JREL_V5 no longer assembles and solves the moment operator whose results that branch discards (tridiagonal set-up, THOMAS, advection re-solve, EDD_JREL_VAR_V3), no longer zeroes and scans the full TX/TVX(ND,ND,NM) every frequency, and DO_VAR_CONT applies its TX statements to the diagonal only (TX is zero off the diagonal and TVX is zero on this branch; cost ND per matrix instead of ND*ND) and copies only the local band into dJ_LOC. The statements that define the response are unchanged; TX, TVX, dJ_LOC, VJ and the BA are the same numbers. QSTARS_ALI_LIN_SLOW (non-empty) selects the full path of builds <= 32; QSTARS_ALI_LIN_HASH=n writes per-frequency hashes of TX/TVX/dJ_LOC/VJ (diagnostic); the path taken is recorded in QSTARS_ALI_LIN_PATH. QS_LIN_FAC=0 passes (builds 19/21 branch) execute no new arithmetic.
